name: Dalaran Patrols
summary: Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill cares nothing for why the wizards of Dalaran raised a great dome of magic over their city's heart. What matters is that the ruined outskirts beyond the dome may conceal treasures of real magical worth, while the wizards and their elemental slaves patrol the area. Voidglare wants those patrols thinned.

sections.title: Treasures in the Ruins
sections.body: After Prison Break In, Voidglare turns to the wizards of Dalaran, who raised a great dome of magic over their city's heart. Some say it shelters them from the violence of the age; others say they simply wanted solitude to study and plot. Voidglare does not care which. The ruined outskirts beyond the dome may conceal treasures of real magical worth, but the wizards and their elemental slaves patrol the area. You are to hunt six Dalaran Summoners and twelve Elemental Slaves, then return to Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

faq.q: Why does Magus Voidglare want the patrols thinned?
faq.answer: Voidglare thinks the ruined outskirts of Dalaran beyond the dome may conceal treasures of real magical worth, but the wizards and their elemental slaves patrol the area.

faq.q: What is the magical dome around Dalaran?
aliases: why is dalaran in a bubble
